description:
Make the Rust CI gate fail on broken rustdoc and failing doctests.

## Background

`scripts/cargo-ci.sh` runs build, nextest, clippy and formatting. nextest does not run doctests, and the script builds no rustdoc. GitHub CI builds rustdoc in release mode but does not deny warnings. `cargo doc` currently emits warnings in `gf2-core` and `gf2-sim`, including unresolved and private intra-doc links.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` runs a release-mode `cargo doc --workspace --no-deps` with rustdoc warnings denied and a release-mode doctest run, each as its own reported step.
- [hard] REQ-02: GitHub CI runs the same two steps with the same flags and feature set.
- [hard] REQ-03: All current rustdoc warnings and failing doctests are fixed, and both steps pass.
- [hard] REQ-04: The added steps keep the gate within its configured time budget, with the measured step durations recorded in the commit message or a linked record.
title: Build rustdoc and run doctests in the Rust CI gate
